name: Cubic Interpolation (Mitchell-Netravali)
definition: A family of cubic filters defined by parameters B and C, providing C0 and C1 continuity to prevent high-frequency leakage artifacts.
summary: Mitchell-Netravali cubic interpolation is a kernel-based resampling method that uses tunable parameters to balance blurring and ringing while ensuring C1 continuity to prevent high-frequency leakage artifacts.
